title: EU designates ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the DSA
summary: The European Commission placed ChatGPT (with Reddit and Roblox) under the DSA's strictest tier, requiring systemic-risk assessments, mitigation and researcher data access within four months.
reason: First binding EU systemic-risk regime applied to a frontier chatbot.

title: Data-center backlash: Trump warns holdouts as ~$130B of projects face protests
summary: Trump warned communities rejecting data centres would fall behind China, while Sam Altman acknowledged 'people hate data centers' with about $130B of projects facing protests, delays or cancellations.
reason: Evidence of widespread local opposition; from newsletter digest.

title: Meta to pay up to $18B to settle multistate child-safety suits
summary: Meta agreed to pay up to $18 billion over a decade to settle state child-safety lawsuits and add default teen usage limits.
reason: Major tech accountability outcome; mostly social media, so T1. Source is a digest.

title: SB Energy plans 10GW Ohio AI campus, gives OpenAI $5.5B in warrants
summary: SoftBank-owned SB Energy granted OpenAI warrants worth about $5.5B with a 20-year lease for a planned 10GW Ohio campus powered mostly by new gas.
reason: Further compute scale-up for one lab.

title: Bank of England's Bailey warns G20 frontier AI is changing cyber risk
summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey told G20 finance ministers that frontier AI could change financial-sector cyber risk.

title: UK opens first competitions in £100M sovereign AI procurement scheme
summary: The UK launched the first competitions under a £100M programme to buy AI from domestic firms.

title: China state-media-linked account rebukes Anthropic before US-China AI talks
summary: A CCTV-linked account criticised Anthropic ahead of planned US-China AI talks.
reason: Hostile rhetoric before bilateral talks; minor.

title: NHS watchdog: AI scribes get drug names and diagnoses wrong
summary: Healthwatch England reported errors in AI-generated medical records, including a confused drug name and a misreported diagnosis.
reason: Public-sector warning on AI reliability in health.

title: Thailand's TH-AI Passport national AI-skills platform goes live
summary: Thailand launched a national platform giving citizens 15+ access to 33 AI models and 96+ training courses, with free introductory access.
reason: Public AI access and reskilling programme; single blog source.
